## bring every lead into focus.

multi-channel lead capture

A website form instantly creates a lead, sends an email, and schedules a follow-up. Both appear in your intake dashboard with source and priority.

lead nurturing

Prospects enter automated nurturing with educational emails and reminders. When ready, they book a consult and your team sees the full communication history.

seamless lead to case conversion

A signed engagement turns the lead into a case with one click. All notes, contacts, and documents transfer, and a new-case workflow begins.

integration with answering services

An answering service logs after-hours calls as new leads. By morning, your team sees each one prioritized with caller details and preferred contact method.
